content: This paper presents a novel methodology for simultaneous feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical responses, using an optimization framework that combines logistic loss and functional features. The approach employs functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional data, demonstrating its effectiveness through simulations and an application to chronic disease analysis.
